policy.purpose: Hear the target in a short sentence or question; direct picture matching is sufficient.
policy.sharedCards: Exact card IDs, source bytes and status are shared across contexts and correct/distractor roles.
policy.question: At most one short question, omitted when the sentence directly identifies the answer.
policy.status: Text and shared-card review draft; no new audio, artwork generation or production activation.

cards.label: Three adult humans
cards.brief: Exactly three adult human characters, all fully visible with separate silhouettes and no background people. Use the same character/style family as the two-adult demo card. No numeral labels.

cards.label: Four adult humans
cards.brief: Exactly four adult human characters, all fully visible with separate silhouettes and no background people. Match people-3 and the two-adult demo card. No numeral labels.

cards.label: Large box
cards.brief: One large box; match the other three size-family cards, with the same neutral scale reference in the same position. Change only object and relative size. All subjects fully visible; no size labels or arrows. Large/small must be clear at answer-card size.

cards.label: Small box
cards.brief: One small box; match the other three size-family cards, with the same neutral scale reference in the same position. Change only object and relative size. All subjects fully visible; no size labels or arrows. Large/small must be clear at answer-card size.

cards.label: Large ball
cards.brief: One large ball; match the other three size-family cards, with the same neutral scale reference in the same position. Change only object and relative size. All subjects fully visible; no size labels or arrows. Large/small must be clear at answer-card size.

cards.label: Small ball
cards.brief: One small ball; match the other three size-family cards, with the same neutral scale reference in the same position. Change only object and relative size. All subjects fully visible; no size labels or arrows. Large/small must be clear at answer-card size.

cards.label: Lifting the box
cards.brief: Kiku lifting a box upward with both paws; clearly grounded starting position and one upward motion arrow. Match lower-box exactly except movement direction. No extra boxes, duplicate/ghost limbs or numerals.

cards.label: Lowering the box
cards.brief: Kiku lowering the same box toward the floor with both paws and one downward motion arrow. Match lift-box exactly except movement direction. No extra boxes, duplicate/ghost limbs or numerals.

cards.label: Mount Fuji
cards.brief: Recognizable symmetrical Mount Fuji silhouette and characteristic snow cap, whole landscape, in the established illustration style. Avoid using a generic mountain as a Fuji identity cue. This is a familiar landmark recognition card; review recognizability before acceptance.

cards.label: Artificial flower
cards.brief: An obviously manufactured plastic flower with broad molded construction, visibly rigid petals and a plastic stem/joint. Match natural-flower framing/scale. Do not rely on color, tiny seams, a robot symbol or labels. If the distinction is not clear at small card size, revise the shared concept before acceptance.

cards.label: Artificial grass
cards.brief: Artificial turf shown as a partly rolled piece with its broad manufactured backing clearly visible. Match natural-grass framing/scale; natural grass has visible roots/soil. The distinction must remain clear at small card size without color, labels or tiny seams.

cards.label: Natural flower
cards.brief: One natural flower specimen on a neutral surface, matched composition/scale to its natural/artificial counterpart. Artificial objects visibly show manufactured plastic material/seams; natural objects have organic leaves/petals or roots/soil. Do not rely on a robot metaphor, labels, color alone or hidden production history. Needs visual distinction review.

cards.label: Natural grass
cards.brief: A patch of natural grass with organic roots and soil clearly visible; match artificial-grass framing/scale. The roots/soil versus the manufactured turf backing must remain clear at small card size without labels.

grammarNotes: Polite noun/adjective sentences with です.
Existence/location with に・上・下 and あります/います.
Simple movement/action with に・から・を and ます.
Familiar requests with てください and quantity + 下さい.
The two negative 大した phrases remain explicit review points.
大きさ appears in its short question; other targets occur in the sentence.
